facts.note: Felix says that when the temple bell struck nine his watch said twenty minutes to nine, and that his uncle made a scene about it in front of everyone.
Felix says he went up to the library after dinner and stayed there alone.

Felix gives the thump above him in the atelier and the repeater at eighteen minutes past ten by his watch. He counted the ten slow deep notes, then heard doubled notes, then quick high ones he did not count.

Felix gives someone going quickly up past the library door at a quarter past ten by his watch, and someone coming quickly down at twenty-one minutes past ten. He did not see who, because the door was shut.
Felix says Bastien Girard came into the library at thirty-two minutes past ten by his watch, and they sat together until the temple struck eleven.
